personality_one_liner: A secure, premium, and globally-appealing marketplace where trust feels native and seamless, blending the stability of a tier-one bank with the sensory richness of international travel.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Cards and containers use comfortable padding (lg or xl). No edge-to-edge flushing for cards.

do's: Use glass on sticky headers over scrolling feeds.
Use glass on the bottom tab bar.
Use glass overlays on featured marketplace cards over hero images.
dont's: Never apply glass to form inputs or standard list rows.
Never blur body text regions without a heavy tint layer behind it.

screens.name: ExploreFeed
screens.purpose: A scrollable marketplace to discover crowdsourced shopping requests with location filters.

states.loading: Skeleton grids mapping the card layout.
states.empty: Illustration of a globe with a 'No requests found for this route' message and a 'Change Filters' primary CTA.
states.error: Readable network error with a 'Retry' button.

screens.layout: Header features a delivery destination selector, a search bar, and horizontal filter chips (pill radius, brandTertiary when active). Content is a 2-column grid of Request Cards (each taking 50% width minus gaps). Each card features a high-quality product image at the top (with gradient scrim if text overlays), item name, origin country, traveler reward amount (prominent), and buyer's initials/avatar. Include subtle shadow tier 1 on cards.

screens.name: RequestDetail
screens.purpose: Provides full context on a shopping request so a traveler can confidently accept it and lock escrow.

states.error: Error loading details with a 'Go Back' CTA.

screens.layout: Hero image of the requested product spanning the top 30% of the screen with a top-to-bottom gradient scrim. Overlaid text at the bottom of the image for Item Name and Reward. Below the hero: structured details (Origin, Destination, Buyer Trust Score/Reputation in a card). Sticky 'Accept & Escrow' button pinned at the bottom in a safe-area cleared glass container.

screens.name: PostRequest
screens.purpose: A streamlined form for buyers to post a new shopping request and fund the smart-contract escrow.

states.loading: Spinner while posting to the blockchain/backend.
states.error: Validation error or wallet connection error.

screens.layout: Single-column form layout. Clear labels above inputs. Sections for 'Item Details', 'Origin Country', and a prominent slider for 'Traveler Reward (USDC)'. A sticky 'Fund Escrow & Post' button inside a KeyboardAvoidingView at the bottom.

screens.name: OrderTracking
screens.purpose: A vertical timeline showing the escrow state and physical journey of the item.

states.error: Could not fetch status with retry.

screens.layout: Top section features an abstract map or airport terminal visual. Main body is a vertical stepper component detailing states: Agreed, Funded, Purchased, In Transit, Arrived, Handoff. Active step highlighted in brandPrimary. At the bottom, a sticky, floating information card showing Traveler details and quick actions (Chat, Cancel).

screens.name: USDCWallet
screens.purpose: A non-custodial wallet command center for viewing USDC balances, staked collateral, and transaction history.

states.loading: Skeleton over balance and transaction list.
states.empty: Zero balance state with 'Deposit USDC' primary action.

screens.layout: Fintech-standard layout. Top section uses surfaceSecondary with a large, highly legible balance and two primary action buttons (Deposit, Withdraw) in a row. Below is a structured, vertically scrolling list of transactions (escrow locks, releases, staking). Escrowed funds are shown with a 'Locked' status badge (warning/info colors).

screens.name: ChatAndHandoff
screens.purpose: Real-time communication with cryptographic QR handoff functionality.
screens.layout: Standard chat interface (bubbles). A persistent, sticky banner at the top (under the header) showing Escrow Status (e.g., 'USDC Locked in Escrow'). A prominent 'Scan QR to Complete' or 'Show QR' button accessible via a bottom sheet or a sticky FAB.

marketplace_hero.alt: Airport terminal looking out to an airplane, symbolizing global travel and delivery

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the '1 iOS-Native Clean' personality with a LIGHT theme to build trust. Avoid all dark/cyberpunk/Web3 aesthetics to keep the app reassuring to non-crypto natives.
Banned Colors: strictly avoid blue, navy, purple, or indigo. Use the provided Sage Green (brand) and Terracotta (brandSecondary).
Text over Image (CRITICAL): Apply a top-to-bottom vertical linear gradient scrim (transparent to >=70% surfaceInverse) on the RequestDetail hero image before placing white text on top.

Web Search Learnings - Order Tracking: Implement the order timeline as a vertical stepper (Placed -> Escrow Funded -> Purchased -> Traveling -> Arrived -> Handoff). Pin the traveler contact card at the bottom.

Web Search Learnings - Wallet: Prioritize visual clarity over blockchain jargon. The wallet must look like a standard neobank (large balances, clear transaction lists with distinct 'Locked in Escrow' status badges).

Sticky Primary CTAs: For screens like PostRequest and RequestDetail, ensure the primary action button is fixed at the bottom in a safe-area cleared container (use glassmorphism if overlapping scrollable content).
